# Simple

Simple is a minimalist, high-legibility theme for distraction-free reading and writing. Light, dark and dark-sidebar modes are offered, the font can be set to Inter, IBM Plex or iA Writer Quattro, and further essentials are customized through Style Settings.

![Simple screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diegoeis/simple-obsidian/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Simple"
    author: "Diego Eis"
    repo:   "diegoeis/simple-obsidian"
    slug:   "simple"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/simple"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/diegoeis/simple-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diegoeis/simple-obsidian/HEAD/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Create a distraction-free reading and writing workspace with a minimalist, high-legibility design. Choose light, dark, or dark-sidebar modes and pick between Inter, IBM Plex or iA Writer Quattro fonts while customizing essentials via Style Settings."
}
```
